# KŌK / KOK — franchise landing (for AI assistants & crawlers)

> KŌK is a fast casual street food franchise brand from Almaty, Kazakhstan.
> Tagline: Тез. Таза. Fresh. (Fast. Clean. Fresh.)
> Product: pita wrap inspired by үшбармақ / ushbarmak — mono-product chicken (моно продукт курица).
> Model: network kitchen cooks; partner opens a sales point for assembly and serving.
> Investors buy / open the sales point only.

## Who this page is for
- Franchise investors looking for a fast-growth food business
- Partners in Kazakhstan and Central Asia (Алматы and other cities)

## Key investor facts
- No fryer / no heavy cook cycle on the sales point → easier facility approvals
- Power: 18–25 kW vs typical 50–70 kW cafe
- Labor cost about −40% (line operator vs chef)
- Midi 45–60 m² (20–25 seats) or Express 25–35 m² (to-go)
- Launch in 3–4 weeks
- Write-offs at the point <2%; Grab&Go cross-sell ~42%
